Title: Azure Repos adds a default branch at the org-level

Body.Content:
In previous weeks, we have worked and released the default repository branch setting, and as an addition to that, we're now announcing an option to set an org-level default branch. 

Other key features to enhance the overall user experience are now available:

Azure Boards

  • Customize work item state when pull request is merged
  • Parent field on the task board

Azure Repos

  • Org-level setting for default branch
  • Add a new auth scope for contributing PR comments

Azure Pipelines

  • Configure draft PR validation for GitHub repositories
